design_brief.description: Folding whip RF antenna module represented as a tapered cylindrical whip with a fixed straight base section and a hinge/pivot located along the axis, intended to mount through a panel with a specified gap to accommodate washers and nuts.

metadata.description: Folding whip RF antenna module: tapered whip with fixed base section, hinge block with pivot pin hole, and panel-mount shank with spacer region. Single connected solid.
